studio.title: Design without leaving QuickBiz
studio.intro: Flyers, posters, social posts and business cards, editable down to the last letter and exportable as PNG, JPG or PDF.
studio.emptyBody: Start from a blank canvas at a standard size, or open a template and make it yours.
studio.loadFailedTitle: Your designs could not be loaded
studio.loadFailedBody: This is usually a storage permission problem in the browser rather than a fault with the design itself.
studio.storageNote: Designs are saved in this browser on this device. Clearing site data removes them, so export anything you want to keep.
studio.storageBlocked: This browser is blocking local storage, so designs will only last while this tab stays open. Export a project file before you close it.
studio.unavailableTitle: Creative Studio is not part of this build
studio.unavailableBody: The editor is disabled in this release. Your saved designs are untouched and will appear here when the studio is enabled.
studio.dialogBody: Pick a canvas size. Everything can be changed later.
studio.nameRequired: Give the design a name so you can find it later.
studio.name: Name
studio.openFailedTitle: That design could not be opened
studio.openFailedBody: It may have been deleted from this browser, or the link is incomplete.
studio.nothingSelectedBody: Select an element on the canvas to change its properties.
studio.uploadHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB. Images are re-encoded and stored on this device.
studio.uploadEmpty: Choose a file to add it to the design.
studio.uploadFailed: That image could not be added.
studio.exportBody: Choose a format and size. Exports are created on this device.
studio.exportFailed: The export failed. Try a smaller size.
studio.exportPdfNote: PDF exports are image-based: the text is not selectable and the file is larger than a vector PDF.
studio.recoverBody: This design was changed after it was last saved. Recover the newer version or keep the saved one.
studio.storageFull: This device is out of storage space. Export a project file and delete older designs.
studio.templateBody: Every template opens as a fully editable design.
studio.aiTextBody: AI text assistance is not available yet. Every element can still be written and edited by hand.
studio.aiImageBody: AI image generation is not available yet. Upload your own images, or build from the shapes and templates.
studio.editorUnavailable: The editor could not start on this device.
studio.aiTextUnavailable: AI writing assistance is not available yet.
